messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Teguh Sinar Food Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Kuala Lumpur (Food & Beverage).", "The register lists 3 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (62.56%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 20,207,092 and the after-tax profit was RM 944,841.", "The record lists 5 court cases (5 as plaintiff). 2 are marked pending."], "menu": {"case": {"fact": "In CASE-2024-3565, the company is the plaintiff in a debt recovery (Pending, claim RM 403,000).", "next_check": "Check the latest docket entry for CASE-2024-3565."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was RM 2,089,111.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 7,533,168.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "filings": {"fact": "FY2023 is missing between FY2022 and FY2024.", "next_check": "Obtain comparable filings before interpreting the change in revenue."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 2.04×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was 4.7%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 2014-10-26.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}}}
